errors.text: The requested critical threshold is not identified as 900 K; the response instead states that it cannot be determined.
It predicts loss of stacking-fault contrast, whereas the target reports an increasing HCP atom fraction with temperature before rapid lattice disorder dominates.
The asserted temperature-induced reduction in stacking-fault energy, cross-slip, and homogeneous disordering is unsupported by the supplied evidence and is not the reported mechanism.
